comment.narrative: The target is at least 20 students will be enrolled in each advanced course out of which at least 30 will be female.

As per the Progress Report 5 July 2019 4 July 2020 p.7The two advanced courses were conducted and another was partially conducted each with a total of 30 students. These were drawn from the English speaking group that successfully completed the prerequisite courses that were offered to the Anglophone group in October 2019. The 30 students were drawn from 17 African OACP countries. The Indicator is assessed per course Total number of participants is 303015 75.

description.narrative: Number of participants enrolled in each prerequisite course (out of which at least 30% will be female)

comment.narrative: The target is that at least 20 participants will be enrolled in each course out of which at least 30 will be female.

As per the Progress Report 5 July 2019 4 July 2020 p.7Under the training component trapca has so far completed conducting the six planned Pre requisite courses and two advanced level courses out of the six planned for the period under review. The completed prerequisite courses were for the Anglophone and Francophone cohort. Each cohort successfully completed 3 planned courses that covered the economic aspects of trade legal aspects of trade and the quantitative aspects of international trade. A total of 30 students took part in the Anglophone course compared to the planned 20 similarly 30 against the planned 20 students attended the TRP 400 for the Francophone cohort. The Indicator is assessed per course Total number of participants is 3030 60.
